::: {#def-psrf}
#### Potential scale reduction factor

Suppose $m$ chains each contribute $n$ draws of a parameter $\theta$ after burn-in,
with chain means $\bar\theta_1, \ldots, \bar\theta_m$,
overall mean $\bar\theta$,
and within-chain sample variances $s_1^2, \ldots, s_m^2$.
Let

$$
\ba
W &\eqdef \frac{1}{m} \sumto{j}{m} s_j^2
&& \text{(within-chain variance)}\\
B &\eqdef \frac{n}{m - 1} \sumto{j}{m} \paren{\bar\theta_j - \bar\theta}^2
&& \text{(between-chain variance)}\\
\hat V &\eqdef \frac{n - 1}{n} W + \frac{1}{n} B
&& \text{(pooled variance estimate)}.
\ea
$$

The **Gelman--Rubin potential scale reduction factor** is

$$
\hR \eqdef \sqrt{\hat V / W}.
$$
:::
